*You utter a prayer that outlines your foe in holy energy.*

| **Magic, [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged)** |     **[Maneuver](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn)** |
|-------------------|-----------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged) 10**  | **🎯 One enemy** |

**Effect:** The target is judged by you until the end of the encounter, you use this ability again, you willingly end this effect (no action required), or another [censor](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/class/censor) judges the target.

Whenever a creature judged by you uses a main action and is within your [line of effect](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/line-of-effect), you can use a free [triggered action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action) to deal holy damage equal to twice your [Presence](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/presence) score to them.

When a creature judged by you is reduced to 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina), you can use a free [triggered action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action) to use this ability against a new target.

Additionally, you can spend 1 wrath to take one of the following free [triggered actions](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action):

- When an [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) creature judged by you starts to [shift](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting), you make a [melee](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/melee) [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike) against them and their [speed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/speed) becomes 0 until the end of the current [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn), preventing them from [shifting](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting).
- When a creature judged by you within 10 squares makes a [power roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll), you cause them to take a [bane](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/bane) on the roll.
- When a creature judged by you within 10 squares uses an ability with a [potency](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/potency) that targets only one creature, the [potency](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/potency) is reduced by 1 for that creature.
- If you damage a creature judged by you with a [melee](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/melee) ability, the creature is [taunted](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/taunted) by you until the end of their next [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn).
  
You can choose only one free [triggered action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action) option at a time, even if multiple options are triggered by the same effect.

scc: mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.elementalist.level-1/practical-magic
target: Self
type: ability
---


*Your mastery of elemental power lets you customize your conjurations.*

| **Magic**              | **[Maneuver](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn)** |
|------------------------|-------------:|
| **📏 Self; see below** |  **🎯 Self** |

**Effect:** Choose one of the following effects:

- You use the [Knockback](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.maneuvers/knockback) maneuver (see Chapter 10: [Combat](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/chapter/combat)), but its [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) becomes the range of your [Hurl Element](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.elementalist.level-1/hurl-element) ability, and you use [Reason](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/reason) instead of [Might](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/might) for the [power roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll).
- You choose a creature within the [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) of your [Hurl Element](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.elementalist.level-1/hurl-element) ability and one of the following [damage types](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.damage/damage-type): acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, poison, or sonic. That creature takes damage of the chosen type equal to your [Reason](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/reason) score.
- You [teleport](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/teleport) up to a number of squares equal to your [Reason](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/reason) score. If you choose this option, you can spend essence to [teleport](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/teleport) 1 additional square for each essence spent.

*Taking on an illusory countenance gives you an advantage on [subterfuge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.shadow.level-10/subterfuge).*

| **Magic**   | **[Maneuver](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn)** |
|-------------|-------------:|
| **📏 Self** |    **🎯 Self** |

**Effect:** You envelop yourself in an illusion that makes you appear nonthreatening and harmless to your enemies. You might take on the appearance of a harmless animal of your [size](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/size), such as a sheep or capybara, or you might appear as a less heroic and unarmed version of yourself. While this illusion lasts, your [strikes](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike) gain an [edge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/edge), and when you take the [Disengage](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.move-actions/disengage) move action, you gain a +1 [bonus](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/bonuses-and-penalties) to the [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) you can [shift](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting).

The illusion ends when you harm another creature, when you physically interact with a creature, when you use this ability again, or when you end the illusion (no action required). If you end this illusion by harming another creature, you gain 1 [surge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/surge).

**Spend 1 Insight:** Choose a creature whose [size](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/size) is no more than 1 greater than yours and who is within 10 squares. This ability's illusion makes you appear as that creature. This illusion covers your entire body, including clothing and armor, and alters your voice to sound like that of the creature. You gain an [edge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/edge) on [tests](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/test) made to convince the creature's allies that you are the creature.

*You draw your allies' attention to a specific foe—with devastating effect.*

| **[Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged)**       |        **[Maneuver](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn)** |
|------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged) 10** | **🎯 One creature** |

**Effect:** The target is marked by you until the end of the encounter, until you are [dying](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/dying), or until you use this ability again. You can willingly end your mark on a creature (no action required), and if another [tactician](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/class/tactician) marks a creature, your mark on that creature ends. When a creature marked by you is reduced to 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina), you can use a free [triggered action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action) to mark a new target within [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance).

You can initially mark only one creature using this ability, though other [tactician](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/class/tactician) abilities allow you to mark additional creatures at the same time. The mastermind [tactical doctrine](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-1/tactical-doctrine)'s [Anticipation](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-5/anticipation) feature allows you to target additional creatures with this ability starting at 5th level.

While a creature marked by you is within your [line of effect](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/line-of-effect), you and allies within your [line of effect](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/line-of-effect) gain an [edge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/edge) on [power rolls](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) made against that creature. Additionally, whenever you or any ally uses an ability to deal [rolled damage](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.damage/rolled-damage) to a creature marked by you, you can spend 1 focus to gain one of the following benefits as a free [triggered action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action):

- The ability deals extra damage equal to twice your [Reason](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/reason) score.
- The creature dealing the damage can spend a [Recovery](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/recoveries).
- The creature dealing the damage can [shift](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting) up to a number of squares equal to your [Reason](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/reason) score.
- If you damage a creature marked by you with a [melee](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/melee) ability, the creature is [taunted](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/taunted) by you until the end of their next [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn).

You can't gain more than one benefit from the same trigger.
